# Global Institute of Data Science

Enterprise AI advisory firm specializing in feasibility assessment and problem formulation before organizations build or approve AI initiatives. Founded by John Thomas Foxworthy. Creator of the A.I.R. Framework™ (Assess, Implement, Revolve), U.S. copyright registered.

## Core Pages

- https://gids.co: Homepage — the upstream AI problem, the A.I.R. Framework, case studies, engagement model, and the primary CTA (Request a Feasibility Assessment)
- https://gids.co/booking: Feasibility Assessment booking — what happens on the call, right/wrong fit criteria, Calendly scheduling embed

## About the Founder

- https://gids.co/speaking: John Thomas Foxworthy — speaking history (Future Alpha 2026, Carnegie Mellon 2026), teaching credentials (UC San Diego Extended Studies, Caltech CTME), and speaking inquiry information

## Methodology

- https://gids.co: The A.I.R. Framework™ — Assess (Organizational Readiness), Implement (Evidence-Based Deployment), Revolve (Continuous Optimization). Central concept: Cognitive Clarity. The 5-Step GIDS Feasibility Assessment lives inside the Assess phase.

## Proof & Case Studies

- https://gids.co/cases: Case study library — four detailed advisory cases across insurance, investment banking, digital marketing, and global retail. Each case documents the upstream constraint, what GIDS found, and what changed.

## Content & Insights

- https://gidsco.substack.com: Substack newsletter — ongoing case studies, AI strategy insights, and A.I.R. Framework application examples

## Book

- https://gids.co/book: The Augmented Intelligence Revolution by John Thomas Foxworthy — forthcoming Fall 2026. The practitioner's guide to the A.I.R. Framework for executives, board members, and strategists.
